<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugins/upload"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Developer mode only. The body is the raw .tmxplug (at most 50 MB).
 The release's .sig may come base64 encoded in the
 X-Termix-Plugin-Signature header; an official one makes the file
 install as an official plugin, and it may then fill in a plugin
 whose download failed.
The file is checked (archive, manifest, plugin API) and held for 30 minutes, but nothing is loaded. The answer lists what it asks for so the admin can agree, then POST /plugins/upload/\{token\}/install installs it. A file can replace an earlier upload with the same id, never a bundled or registry plugin.
